verses.1: A song of ascents. I rejoiced when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
verses.2: Our feet are now standing in your gates, Jerusalem.
verses.3: Jerusalem, you are built as a city whose unity is one.
verses.4: For there the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony to Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
verses.5: For there are thrones for judgment, thrones of the house of David.
verses.6: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May peace come to those who love you.”
verses.7: May peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
verses.8: For the sake of my brothers and companions, I will now speak of peace for you.
verses.9: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.

notes:
Notes
- v. 1: The phrase "A song of ascents" is a title commonly associated with a pilgrimage song, hence the translation of "ma'lot" as "ascents."
- v. 3: The Hebrew "k'ir she'chubberet lah yachdav" is translated to "built as a city whose unity is one" to reflect the metaphor of unity in Jerusalem.
- v. 4: "Shivtei-Yah" is interpreted as "the tribes of the LORD" to reflect the divine association with the tribes of Israel.
- v. 5: The reference to "councils of judgment" is rendered as "thrones for judgment" to convey the judicial role within the city.
